summary: Ambev S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting board resolutions approving capital returns to shareholders. The board approved payment of the third and final installment of interest on capital (IOC) from December 2025, gross R$0.1185 per share, payable October 6, 2026, and a new IOC July 2026 distribution of gross R$0.0713 per share, payable by December 31, 2026, with record dates September 21 (B3) and September 23 (NYSE) and ex-dividend date September 22, 2026. The IOC offsets mandatory minimum dividends. No premium, price, or merger terms apply; this is a routine capital return event. Watch for future dividend policies.
